scripts.build: npm run build:worker && npm run build:ui
scripts.test: npm run build:worker && node --experimental-sqlite --test test/portal-otp.test.mjs test/portal-session.test.mjs test/portal-ratelimit.test.mjs test/portal-worker.test.mjs && node --test test/openapi.test.mjs test/staging-portal-drill.test.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npm run generate:wrangler-types && tsc -p tsconfig.worker.typecheck.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.dry-run: npm run build && npx wrangler deploy --dry-run --config wrangler.example.jsonc
scripts.migrate:local: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --config ../cloudflare-licensing-backend/wrangler.example.toml
